origins.section: Protected Opens the Package, and Other Packages Only Through the Subclass's Own Type
No Modifier Means Package-Private, and a Subclass in Another Package Can't Override It
An Override May Widen Access but Never Narrow It
setAccessible Opens Private Members of Class-Path Code, Not of the JDK

recorded.outcome:q-protected-through-base: Page: 'Outside the package, a subclass reaches a protected instance member only through an expression of its own type or a subtype; the compiler checks the declared type of the expression, not the object at run time.' SessionCache example: other.evict compiles, any.evict is rejected.

Gaps noted: IllegalAccessException being checked is inferred; getDeclaredFields order unspecified.
